description: Pipeline execution hardening: fail-fast, replace-step, run_until termination

test_cases.description: Pipeline stops at failing step when ignore_errors is false
Pipeline continues when step has ignore_errors: true
Configuring an existing step replaces it, not duplicates it
Pipeline halts when run_until predicate returns true after step N
Pipeline step resolution uses O(1) lookup (verified by implementation)

D-142 (PROTOCOL_SPEC 5.16.1): a step that runs past its `timeout_ms` fails with MODULE_TIMEOUT, and that is the code the caller of call() receives — the same code a module timeout carries. Driver: insert a custom step named `slow_step` after `module_lookup` whose body waits `sleep_ms` (the language's ordinary non-blocking wait), configure it with `timeout_ms`, register a trivial module and call it through Executor.call. apcore-typescript's step timer rejected with a plain Error, which reached the caller as MODULE_EXECUTE_ERROR.
The control for the case above: the same step finishing inside its `timeout_ms` does not fail the call.
